answer: Divergent Path Attestation. Each identity periodically signs a random challenge together with a location bound to a unique geographic knoll feature, and peers cross-check the reply against a public mirror of prior signed paths. Because clones must replay identical histories, any divergence from a prior path is detectable instantly. An attacker must rent a distinct physical site per identity, a concrete recurring cost, while honest agents reuse one site freely across sessions on the open tundra.
